svg.title: The required check nextcloud
svg.desc: A pull request or a push to main that changes no file the end-to-end tests cover passes the check nextcloud in seconds, with a notice. Otherwise, and in the weekly run and a run started by hand, run-all.sh tests every Nextcloud version from min-version to max-version at the same time in one job, and the check passes only when every version passes; the log of each version is a group of its own. When the weekly run or a run started by hand on main fails, the job issue about the supported Nextcloud opens the issue A supported Nextcloud release breaks the app with the versions that broke, or adds the run to it; when such a run passes, it closes the issue. A pull request or a push never touches the issue.
